copy.title: The build ledger
copy.desc_land: Each column is one numbered handoff, the file that passes this site’s work from one session to the next, oldest on the left. Each line is an item a handoff left open, running from the handoff that opened it to the one that closed it, in bands by workstream. Lines still open run to the right edge; dotted ones are parked on purpose or waiting on me.
copy.desc_port: Each row is one numbered handoff, the file that passes this site’s work from one session to the next, oldest at the top. Each line is an item a handoff left open, running from the handoff that opened it to the one that closed it, in bands by workstream. Lines still open run to the bottom edge; dotted ones are parked on purpose or waiting on me.
copy.caption_html: The build ledger. Time runs in numbered handoffs: the files that pass this site’s work from one session to the next. Each line is an item a handoff left open, running until the session that closed it. Teal lines are still open; dotted ones are parked on purpose or waiting on me. A script draws it from the handoffs themselves, and leaves out items about my other sites. How I work · This site’s case study
copy.summary: The ledger as a list, one line per handoff

traps.caption: The bottom band is the traps: mistakes a session wrote down so the next one would not repeat them. Each runs from the handoff that recorded it, dotted where that start is worked out from its count. A square end means a check or a script now does its job, a short bar that it was retired, and an open dot marks a session where it helped.
traps.desc_land: The bottom band, traps, has one line per mistake a session wrote down for the next: from the handoff that recorded it to the one that retired it or moved it into code, with a dot at each session where it helped.
traps.desc_port: The right-hand band, traps, has one line per mistake a session wrote down for the next: from the handoff that recorded it to the one that retired it or moved it into code, with a dot at each session where it helped.

001.line: From a standing start to a live site on tc-ventures.ca.

002.line: I read the copy that was already public and ruled on every block; all four pages were rewritten.

003.line: A voice pass, a second résumé rebuild and the contact page. The rewrite before it was confirmed live, byte for byte.

004.line: Copy fixes from my own corrections, a third résumé pass, a new home-page lede, and scouting data for a graph demo.

005.line: I chose where the graph demo goes and that it is 3D; it was built and tested locally.

006.line: I annotated the previous handoff and handed it back; every ruling in it was acted on the same day.

007.line: The first real deploy: pushed to GitHub, built by Cloudflare, verified serving.

008.line: A real favicon, and two new project write-ups: the Back Quarter and the Desk and the Drawer.

009.line: The previous session’s work taken live and verified; two more project write-ups, and the four sites written up as four briefs.

010.line: A short clean-up: small open items closed, and one correction on my personal site. Nothing here changed.

011.line: Mostly other sites: a crawl audit of the rare-disease site, and two sites moved behind Cloudflare. Here, only the résumé changed.

012.line: Cleared what could be closed without my input: markup fixes on the rare-disease site, and a keyboard path through the graph. Verified live.

013.line: The plan to take this site from skeleton to showcase, written and approved.

014.line: The design system and the case-study template, built on one page with placeholder copy.

015.line: An audit and a phased plan. Phase 0 shipped: clean addresses, security headers, and the home page rewritten from my rulings.

016.line: The receipts inventory ruled, the truth rules written, and the first case study live: the housing society’s site.

017.line: This site’s own case study live, and a Projects sub-menu on every page.

018.line: The method page live, with my own headline and lede.

019.line: I moved the case studies ahead of this ledger. The influence graph’s case study live.

020.line: The rare-disease site’s case study live, after a schema fix on that site and a second look at its host fault.

021.line: Receipts for the last two case studies ruled; their copy drafted, then paused at my word for a decision about the Back Quarter.

022.line: The Back Quarter copy ruled, then work on my personal site: the 3D world on computers only, and three layout fixes.

023.line: The last two case studies live, after a re-trace against the code found the Desk’s description out of date. All six are done.

024.line: This ledger: I ruled the proposal and every line on it, and a script draws it from the handoffs.

025.line: A Display panel for motion, theme, contrast and text size, built into the site. I ruled the plan and the panel’s words.

026.line: A layout pass: the pages now reflow for readers who enlarge the text, and the www address works. I ruled each fix and set up the address myself.

027.line: The motion: the ledger draws itself in, a slider steps through the handoffs, and a case study’s name can grow into its heading. I ruled the slider’s words and how it shows the past.

028.line: The method loop traces itself, a page-change motion that Chrome was dropping is fixed, and one claim on the method page now says only what the record shows. I ruled each change.

029.line: A small fix: on a slow connection, this ledger no longer shows in full for a moment before it draws itself in.
